g.text: Root cause analysis: scope first, then zoom in
a metric moved; split the causes, walk the journey, confirm with one cut
how big, since when, sudden or gradual, where
one metric per step: which step moved?
recent change at that step: release, price, policy
a single data cut beats five guesses
rollback, long-term fix, a test or an alert
a city-only drop points away from global releases
